title: No transform/selection outline drawn when a symbol/MC instance is selected on stage
description:
USER-REPORTED bug.

REPRO: Draw a circle on the stage -> Convert to Symbol (MovieClip) -> with the Selection tool, click the resulting instance on the stage. NO selection outline / transform box / resize+rotate handles appear. Raw shapes (and text/bitmap objects) DO show the dashed bounding box + handles; symbol/MC INSTANCES do not.

SELECTION STATE IS SET (selected-but-not-drawn, NOT a hit-test miss): the selection-tool mousedown has a dedicated symbol-instance hit-test at packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx:2393-2419 ('Hit test symbol instances (AABB derived from library bounds)') that computes bounds via getSymbolInstanceBounds(inst, library) and, on a hit, calls onShapeSelect?.(hitInst.id, e.shiftKey) and starts a drag. So the instance becomes the selected object (selectedShapeId/selectedShapeIds includes its id) and is draggable. The defect is purely that the SELECTION-OUTLINE RENDER never draws anything for it.

ROOT CAUSE (file:line): packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx, selection+transform overlay render block at lines 3481-3556 (inside the main draw effect). For each selected id it does:
  - obj = shapeDisplayObjects.find(o => o.id === selId)  (line 3486) -> draws dashed box + 8 resize handles + rotation handle from transformedShapeBounds(obj).
  - else branch (line 3525): textObj = textDisplayObjects.find(...) ?? bitmapObj = bitmapDisplayObjects.find(...) -> draws box + handles from {x,y,width,height}.
There is NO branch that looks up symbolInstanceDisplayObjects. A selected INSTANCE id is not in shapeDisplayObjects, textDisplayObjects, or bitmapDisplayObjects, so selectedGenericObj is undefined and the block draws NOTHING -> no outline, no handles. (The only instance-aware overlay in this region is the Scale9Grid draw at lines 3558-3617, which uses symbolInstanceDisplayObjects + getSymbolInstanceBounds, but it only renders the 9-slice grid and only when sym.scale9Grid is set -- it is not the selection box.)

INSTANCES HAVE USABLE BOUNDS: getSymbolInstanceBounds(inst, library) (StageArea.tsx:447-496) already returns a valid {x,y,width,height} AABB for any instance by gathering the referenced symbol's frame-0 shape geometry (transformedShapeBounds) and applying inst.x/inst.y + inst.scaleX/scaleY. It is already used by the instance hit-test (2394), the snapping code (2783/2796/2925/2972), and the Scale9Grid overlay (3569). Convert-to-Symbol creates the instance with proper x/y + scale (registration-normalized; see library.ts convert path and tasks 0707/1097), so the box can be sized correctly.

EXPECTED: selecting a symbol/MC instance shows the SAME dashed bounding box + 8 resize handles + rotation handle as a shape, sized to the instance's transformed bounds (getSymbolInstanceBounds, honoring scaleX/scaleY; rotation handling can match the shape path which currently draws an AABB box).
ACTUAL: no outline/box/handles at all for instances.

OTHER NON-SHAPE TYPES: text and bitmap objects ARE handled (the else branch at 3525-3551), so they draw an outline. Groups: if a group is selected and is not present in shapeDisplayObjects/text/bitmap, it would be similarly undrawn -- verify during the fix (groups may be decomposed into shapeDisplayObjects, in which case they are covered). The confirmed gap is the INSTANCE type.

REGRESSION VERDICT: LONG-STANDING, not a recent regression. The selection-outline block dates to 99932271 (2026-06-10) / 4b4e4cf2 (initial); the recent 206830f (task 1245, 2026-06-19) only re-picked colors (themeHalo.haloBlue). Symbol instances were made selectable by a441424 (2026-06-09, 'fix: symbol instances and text objects selectable on stage', tasks 0687/0688) which added the hit-test + selection state but never added the matching outline branch. So instances have been 'selected-but-not-outlined' since selection was first wired.

FIX DIRECTION: in the selection-outline render loop (StageArea.tsx ~3481-3556), add an instance branch: when selId is not a shape/text/bitmap, look it up in symbolInstanceDisplayObjects and, if found, compute bounds = getSymbolInstanceBounds(instObj, library) and draw the same dashed box + (when single-select) the 8 resize handles + rotation handle that the shape branch draws. Use the existing getHandlePositions(bounds) helper. Confirm groups (if a distinct type) are also covered; extend the same lookup if not. Acceptance: selecting a converted MovieClip/Graphic instance on the stage shows the dashed bounding box + transform handles sized to its transformed bounds (a Playwright/visual oracle once the stage port is free; unit-level: assert getSymbolInstanceBounds returns non-zero and the render branch is exercised for an instance id).
